// purpose: Type-check the framework wrappers in src/.
tsconfig.build.json emits their declarations with checkJs off, because it
also compiles the staged html/ closure that html/tsconfig.json already
checks. Nothing checked src/ itself, so this program does — with checkJs and
strict on, like every other JS in this repo.
The wrappers import the element from ../staging/, which is gitignored build
output copied from html/. rootDirs maps staging/ onto html/ so this runs on a
clean checkout, before anything is built.
